Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Ride into the treacherous world of Thunder Junction with the first exhilarating series of pulp magazine cards featuring a gritty cast of rebellious renegades. Each of these cunning outlaws can lead your posse to victory or spell certain defeat if you see them across the table at high noon. Draw!
Art by Miguel Mercado, Stephen Andrade, David Robert Hovey, Aaron J. Riley, and Scott Okumura.
Contents:
• 1x Rainbow Foil Tezzeret the Seeker
• 1x Rainbow Foil Griselbrand
• 1x Rainbow Foil Grenzo, Havoc Raiser
• 1x Rainbow Foil Nicol Bolas, Planeswalker
